description: Hold a high plank with straight elbows. Let the chest sink slightly between the shoulders, then push the floor away to spread the shoulder blades. Keep hips steady and elbows straight. Each full cycle counts once.

name: Seated 90/90 hip switch
description: Sit with both knees bent, one leg in front and one to the side. Rotate both knees across to swap sides, using your hands for balance if needed. Stay within a comfortable hip range. Each change of side counts once.

name: Rock-back thoracic rotation
description: From hands and knees, sit hips toward heels and place one hand behind your head. Rotate that elbow upward, then return it toward the supporting arm. Keep hips still and avoid pulling the neck. Choose one side.

name: Butt kicks
description: Jog gently in place, alternately lifting each heel toward the glutes. Keep your torso upright and land softly. Reduce to alternating standing heel lifts if needed. Count each heel lift as one rep total.

name: Dumbbell Cuban press
description: With two light dumbbells, raise bent elbows to a comfortable height. Rotate the forearms upward, press overhead, then reverse slowly. Keep ribs down and avoid forcing shoulder range. Each full sequence is one rep.

name: Dumbbell reverse-grip bench press
description: Lie on a stable flat bench with two dumbbells, palms facing your head. Lower toward the chest with elbows controlled, then press up. Keep wrists stacked and feet grounded. Each simultaneous press counts once.

name: Dumbbell reverse-grip bent-over row
description: Hold two dumbbells with palms forward and hinge at the hips. Pull toward the lower ribs with elbows close, then lower slowly. Keep your back long and torso still. Each simultaneous row is one rep.

name: Dumbbell single-arm upright row
description: Stand holding one light dumbbell in front of the thigh. Lead with the elbow to lift it close to your torso, stopping at a comfortable height, then lower slowly. Do not shrug or lean. Choose one arm.

name: Dumbbell decline bench press
description: Secure your legs on a purpose-built decline bench. Hold two dumbbells above the chest, lower with controlled elbows, then press up. Use light weights you can position safely. Each simultaneous press is one rep.

name: Kettlebell alternating gorilla row
description: Set two bells between your feet and hinge with bent knees. Row one toward your hip while the other stays grounded, then lower and switch. Keep hips and shoulders square. Count each individual row as one rep total.

name: Kettlebell Sots press
description: Advanced: rack a light bell and lower into a stable deep squat. Stay in the squat as you press overhead and lower to the rack. Keep heels grounded and torso upright; use only a controlled range. Choose one arm.

name: Kettlebell half-kneeling windmill
description: Half-kneel with a light bell overhead on the kneeling side. Hinge sideways toward the free hand while keeping the bell stacked above the shoulder, then return tall. Move slowly within control. Choose one side.

name: Kettlebell tall-kneeling chest press
description: Kneel tall and hold a light bell at chest height with both hands. Brace and press it straight forward, then draw it back. Keep hips extended and avoid leaning back. Each forward press counts once.

name: Kettlebell goblet forward lunge
description: Hold one bell at your chest. Step forward, bend both knees under control and push back to standing. Keep the front knee tracking with the toes. Alternate legs; each lunge counts once.

name: Ankle circles
description: Stand balanced on one leg and lift the other foot slightly. Trace small circles with the toes, then reverse direction. Keep the knee still. Choose one ankle per interval; each full circle counts once.

name: Wrist circles
description: Loosely interlace your fingers in front of you. Rotate the wrists slowly through a comfortable circle without forcing the range. Reverse direction halfway through. Each circle counts once.

name: Standing hip circles
description: Stand with feet apart and knees soft, hands on hips. Move the pelvis in a small circle while keeping feet planted. Reverse direction halfway through. Each complete circle is one rep.

name: Hamstring sweep
description: Step one heel forward with toes raised. Hinge gently at the hips and sweep your hands toward the foot, then stand and switch legs. Keep the range comfortable. Each sweep counts as one rep total.

name: Lateral shuffle
description: Bend the knees slightly and take quick sideways steps, keeping feet from crossing. Use a clear space and reverse direction under control. Stay low with soft landings. Use a seconds target.

name: Grapevine step
description: Step sideways, cross the trailing foot behind, step sideways again and bring feet together. Repeat the other way at a controlled pace in a clear space. One four-step sequence is one rep.

name: Seal jack
description: Jump feet apart while opening your arms sideways at chest height. Jump feet together while bringing palms toward each other in front. Land softly; step instead of jumping to scale. One out-and-in cycle is one rep.

name: Cross jack
description: Start with feet apart and arms out at chest height. Jump to cross feet and arms, then jump open. Alternate which side crosses in front and land softly. Each cross-and-open cycle is one rep.

name: Standing quadriceps stretch
description: Balance on one leg and gently hold the other ankle behind you. Keep knees close and torso upright without arching your back. Hold a comfortable stretch, then switch sides between intervals.

name: Standing figure-four stretch
description: Balance on one leg, rest the opposite ankle above the standing knee and sit the hips back slightly. Keep the chest lifted and avoid pressing on the crossed knee. Hold comfortably; choose a side per interval.

name: Dumbbell overhead shrug
description: Hold light dumbbells overhead with arms extended and ribs steady. Gently lift the shoulders toward the ears, then lower the shoulders without bending elbows. Each lift and lower is one rep.

name: Dumbbell bench pullover
description: Lie along a stable bench, feet grounded, holding one light dumbbell securely above the chest. With elbows softly bent, lower behind the head only as far as controlled, then return. Each return counts once.

name: Dumbbell incline reverse fly
description: Lie chest-down on a stable incline bench with light dumbbells hanging. With elbows slightly bent, lift arms sideways to torso height, then lower slowly. Keep chest supported. Each paired lift counts once.

name: Dumbbell incline shrug
description: Lie chest-down on a stable incline bench with dumbbells hanging and arms straight. Lift the shoulders toward the ceiling without rowing or bending elbows, pause briefly, then lower. Each paired shrug is one rep.

name: Dumbbell seated reverse fly
description: Sit on a stable bench with feet planted. Hinge over your thighs with light dumbbells hanging. Raise both arms sideways with soft elbows, then lower slowly without swinging. Each paired raise is one rep.

name: Kettlebell front-rack march
description: Hold one bell securely at your shoulder. March in place, lifting alternating knees while keeping ribs level and avoiding a sideways lean. Choose one rack side per interval. Each knee lift counts as one rep total.

name: Double kettlebell front-rack walking lunge
description: Rack two bells at the chest. Step into a forward lunge, rise through the front foot and continue with the other leg in a clear space. Keep the trunk steady. Each forward lunge counts as one rep total.

name: Kettlebell lateral step-up
description: Hold a bell at your chest beside a stable low platform. Place the nearer foot fully on top, step up under control and lower to the same side. Avoid pushing off the trailing foot. Choose a side; each ascent counts once.

name: Kettlebell half snatch
description: Advanced: drive one bell from a backswing into a controlled overhead catch. Lower to the rack before swinging into the next rep. Keep the bell close and avoid forearm impact. Choose one arm; each overhead catch is one rep.

name: Kettlebell goblet split squat
description: Hold one bell at the chest in a split stance, both feet on the floor. Bend both knees through a comfortable range, then rise without moving the feet. Keep the front heel down. Choose a side; each rise is one rep.

name: Bodyweight squat hold
description: Lower into a comfortable squat with feet grounded. Hold the position without sinking farther, breathe steadily, then stand to finish.

name: Staggered-stance squat
description: Place one foot slightly behind the other. Sit down and back while keeping most weight through the front foot, then stand. Complete the chosen side before switching.

name: Squat to calf raise
description: Perform a controlled squat. As you stand, rise onto the balls of both feet without jumping, then lower your heels. Count one squat and heel raise as one repetition.

name: Lateral squat walk
description: Hold a shallow squat and take small sideways steps, bringing the trailing foot in without crossing. Keep knees tracking over toes. Count each sideways step; change direction evenly.

name: Single-leg calf raise
description: Balance on one foot on level ground. Lift the heel slowly, pause, then lower without rolling the ankle out. Use a smaller range if needed and complete both sides.

name: Bent-knee calf raise
description: Stand with knees slightly bent and hold that knee angle. Raise both heels, pause, then lower with control. Keep weight spread across the balls of the feet.

name: Standing hamstring curl
description: Stand tall and bend one knee to bring the heel behind you. Keep thighs alongside each other, lower slowly and alternate legs. Count each curl as one repetition.

name: Front-to-back leg swing
description: Balance on one leg and gently swing the other forward and back through a small controlled arc. Keep the torso quiet. Count a forward-and-back cycle as one repetition; change sides.

name: Lateral leg swing
description: Balance on one leg. Move the other leg sideways and gently across the front of the body without twisting the standing knee. Use a small arc; count each out-and-back cycle and switch sides.

name: Hip airplane
description: Balance on one leg with a soft knee and hinge forward. Slowly rotate the pelvis open and closed while keeping the standing foot grounded. Use a small range, then stand and switch sides.

name: Bird-dog crunch
description: From hands and knees, extend opposite arm and leg. Bring that elbow and knee toward each other beneath the trunk, then extend again without shifting sideways. Count each return and alternate sides.

name: Bear-plank shoulder tap
description: From hands and knees, hover the knees just above the floor. Touch one hand to the opposite shoulder and replace it, keeping hips level. Alternate hands and count each tap.

name: Plank jack
description: Start in a high plank. Hop the feet apart and together while keeping the trunk steady. Step one foot at a time to reduce impact. Count one out-and-in cycle as a repetition.

name: High-plank knee to elbow
description: Hold a high plank and draw one knee outward toward the elbow on the same side. Return the foot with control and alternate sides without dropping the hips. Count each knee drive.

name: Forearm-plank rock
description: Hold a forearm plank. Rock gently forward over the elbows and back using the toes, keeping the body in one line. Use a short range and count one forward-and-back cycle.

name: Dead-bug heel tap
description: Lie on your back with knees bent above the hips. Lower one heel to lightly touch the floor, then return and alternate. Keep the trunk still and count each heel tap.

name: Seated straight-leg lift
description: Sit with legs extended and hands beside the hips. Keep the torso tall as you lift one straight leg a short distance and lower it. Alternate sides without leaning back; count each lift.

name: Tall-kneeling hip hinge
description: Kneel tall with knees comfortably apart. Send the hips toward the heels while keeping the back long, then squeeze the glutes to return upright. Move through a comfortable range without arching the back.

name: Lateral bear crawl
description: Hover the knees from hands and knees. Take small sideways steps with hands and feet, keeping hips level. Count each coordinated sideways step and travel both directions.

name: Long-lever forearm plank
description: Start in a forearm plank, then place elbows slightly farther ahead of the shoulders. Brace and hold without sagging. Shorten the reach if needed and breathe throughout.

name: Prone heel beats
description: Lie face down with your forehead resting on your hands. Lift straight legs slightly, separate the heels, then bring them together gently. Keep the pelvis still. Each close and reopen counts as one rep.

name: Arm circles
description: Stand tall with arms extended to the sides. Make small, smooth circles without shrugging. Choose a direction and switch for the next set. One full circle counts as one rep.

name: Arm swings
description: Stand with soft knees. Open your arms to the sides, then cross them comfortably in front of your chest. Alternate which arm crosses above. One open-and-cross cycle counts as one rep.

name: Standing side crunch
description: Stand tall and bring one knee outward toward the elbow on the same side. Return the foot to the floor and alternate sides without pulling your neck. Count each knee lift as one rep.

name: Forearm-plank leg lift
description: From a forearm plank, lift one straight leg a little without turning the hips or arching the back. Lower with control, then alternate legs. Count each lift and return as one rep.

name: Reverse clamshell
description: Lie on your side with hips stacked and knees bent. Keep the knees touching as you rotate the top foot upward, then lower it slowly. Avoid rolling the pelvis. Reps apply to the chosen side.

name: Curtsy lunge
description: Step one foot back and slightly behind the other, bending both knees through a comfortable range. Keep the front knee aligned with its foot. Stand and alternate sides. Each lunge counts as one rep.

name: Ankle hops
description: With feet about hip-width apart and knees soft, make small two-foot hops in place. Land quietly and keep the torso tall. Use a controlled rhythm. Each landing counts as one rep.

name: Quick feet
description: Take a shallow athletic stance and make short, quick alternating steps in place. Keep knees soft and the trunk steady. Maintain a pace you can control for the chosen time.

name: Cross-body mountain climber
description: Start in a high plank. Bring one knee toward the opposite elbow, return it, and alternate legs. Keep shoulders over hands and avoid bouncing the hips. Count each knee drive as one rep.

name: Prone back extension
description: Lie face down with arms beside you and legs resting on the floor. Lift the chest a small, comfortable distance while looking down, pause, then lower slowly. Each lift and return counts as one rep.

name: Lying side crunch
description: Lie on one side with bent knees stacked. Lift the upper shoulder and ribs toward the hip, then lower with control. Support the head lightly without pulling it. Reps apply to the chosen side.

name: Oblique V crunch
description: Lie on your side with legs extended. Lift both legs and the upper torso toward each other, then lower slowly. Use the bottom arm for balance and avoid pulling the neck. Reps apply to the chosen side.

name: Pilates open-leg rocker
description: Balance seated, holding the shins with legs in a comfortable V. Round the back and roll to the shoulder blades, keeping weight off the neck, then return to balance. One back-and-return cycle counts as one rep.

name: Standing kick crunch
description: Stand tall, then lift one leg forward as the opposite hand reaches toward it. Use a comfortable height without forcing the knee straight. Return and alternate sides. Each kick and return counts as one rep.

name: Plank kick-through
description: From a high plank, lift one hand and thread the opposite leg underneath as you rotate toward that side. Return to plank, then alternate. Move slowly with control. Each kick and return counts as one rep.

name: Hindu push-up
description: Start with hips lifted in an inverted V. Bend the elbows and sweep the chest forward near the floor, then straighten the arms within a comfortable range. Lift the hips to return. Each complete cycle is one rep.

name: Diamond kicks
description: Lie on your back with legs raised, knees bent outward and soles together. Extend legs into a comfortable wide V, bring them together, then return to the bent-knee shape. Keep your back steady. Each full cycle is one rep.

name: Bear squat
description: Start on hands and knees with toes tucked. Keep hands planted as you straighten the knees and raise the hips, then bend the knees to return. Stay within a comfortable range. Each rise and return counts as one rep.

name: Squat to side kick
description: Squat with heels grounded, then stand and lift one leg out to the side without leaning far. Lower the foot and repeat, alternating the lifted leg. One squat plus one side lift counts as one rep.
